eps.ov: Convinced by her friend Risa to try "NewWorld Online", Kaede begins her VRMMO adventure by going all-in on defense because she doesn't want to get hurt.
eps.oa: تقنعها صديقتها «ريسا» بتجربة NewWorld Online، فتبدأ «كايدي» مغامرتها في الواقع الافتراضي بأن تضع كل نقاطها في الدفاع، لأنها لا تريد أن تتألم.

eps.ov: Maple enters a battle royal and is hunted down by a horde of players. Risa uses her swimming talent to explore an underwater cave with her character Sally.
eps.oa: تدخل «ميبل» معركة البقاء، فتطاردها جموع من اللاعبين. وتستعمل «ريسا» موهبتها في السباحة لتستكشف كهفاً تحت الماء بشخصيتها «سالي».

eps.ov: After Maple gets nerfed, her and Sally do some exploring before challenging the dungeon that leads to the second level. Can they clear it in time for the second event?
eps.oa: بعد أن تُضعَّف قدرات «ميبل»، تستكشف هي و«سالي» قليلاً قبل أن تتحديا المتاهة المؤدية إلى الطبقة الثانية. أتقدران على اجتيازها في الوقت المناسب للحدث الثاني؟

eps.ov: Though Maple and Sally get off to a clumsy start in the second event, their tenacity and teamwork is rewarded in more ways than one.
eps.oa: تبدأ «ميبل» و«سالي» الحدث الثاني بداية متعثرة، لكن إصرارهما وتعاونهما يُكافآن بأكثر من طريقة.

eps.ov: Maple and Sally make new friends and fall into more trouble as the second event winds down. But to reach their goal of 20 medals, they may have to resort to PvP.
eps.oa: تكسب «ميبل» و«سالي» أصدقاء جدداً وتقعان في مزيد من المتاعب مع اقتراب الحدث الثاني من نهايته. لكن لتبلغا هدفهما، عشرين وساماً، قد تضطران إلى قتال اللاعبين الآخرين.

eps.ov: Maple leaps at the chance to create a guild and searches for a place to call home. But to compete in the upcoming event, they'll need to recruit more help.
eps.oa: تغتنم «ميبل» فرصة تأسيس نقابة، فتبحث عن مكان تتخذه داراً. لكن ليتنافسوا في الحدث القادم سيحتاجون إلى ضم مزيد من الأعوان.

eps.ov: Everyone in the guild is hard at work leveling up and preparing for what's to come. Maple manages to "cheese" her way through a quest to help a sick NPC.
The third event is packed with people making it hard to compete for cowbells. Following the event, Maple gets into gear to explore new content on the third level.
Guilds prepare for all-out war as the big competition finally begins. But sneaky Sally has some tricks up her sleeve that hopefully gives them the upper hand.
Sally faces certain death and there's trouble back at the base. Despite having a good start, if the guild hopes to place top ten, Maple Tree must go on the attack.
Maple Tree is vastly outnumbered and struggles to stay on the board. As guilds get wiped out left and right, they must face a mighty foe that may be their undoing.
Maple may have maxed out her defense, but can she protect her friends and base from a legendary player? This time, Maple may have met her match.
